title: U-2 aerial photo of Lan-chou, PRC, 23 February 1962
description: Dark black-and-white aerial reconnaissance photograph of terrain and built-up areas, captioned "Lan-chou, PRC, 23 February 1962." Chapter 5 text (page 228) describes initial Project TACKLE missions photographing submarine construction at Shanghai and Wu-ch'ang, industrial expansion at Nanking and Ch'ang-sha, and a previously unknown industrial area at Chiang-yu.
